es: Negociar una elección hipotética con presupuesto y dos preferencias.
Comparar opciones y acordar una decisión verificable.

teaching.en: Begin with a shared imaginary budget.
teaching.es: Comienza con un presupuesto imaginario compartido.
teaching.explanationEs: If más pasado establece el marco de negociación.
teaching.audioText: Begin with a shared imaginary budget.

teaching.en: Check what the group can afford.
teaching.es: Comprueba qué puede pagar el grupo.
teaching.explanationEs: Cada precio debe compararse con el límite.
teaching.audioText: Check what the group can afford.

teaching.en: State each person's preference before recommending.
teaching.es: Indica la preferencia de cada persona antes de recomendar.
teaching.explanationEs: No inventes prioridades durante la elección.
teaching.audioText: State each person's preference before recommending.

teaching.en: Compare each preference, benefit and limit for two options.
teaching.es: Compara un beneficio y un límite de dos opciones.
teaching.explanationEs: Would y could mantienen la comparación hipotética.
teaching.audioText: Compare each preference, benefit and limit for two options.

teaching.en: Offer a compromise and ask the group to agree.
teaching.es: Ofrece un compromiso y pide que el grupo llegue a un acuerdo.
teaching.explanationEs: La decisión final debe ser compartida.

el grupo llegue a un acuerdo.

teaching.audioText: Offer a compromise and ask the group to agree.

teaching.en: If Maya and Theo chose among three festival options, Maya would prefer live music and Theo would prefer a full meal. A $180 concert pass would include music but no meal. A $150 food tour would include the meal but no music. A $240 music-and-dinner package could satisfy both preferences, although it would cost more. If I were them, I would recommend that third option. They would agree because it includes both priorities without adding another expense.
teaching.es: Maya y Theo comparan tres opciones ya indicadas y acuerdan el paquete que reúne música y cena.
teaching.explanationEs: El modelo integra hipótesis, modales, consejo, comparación y acuerdo presupuestario.

prompt.es: Elige la hipótesis que respeta un presupuesto de $300.

choices.text: If we had $300, we could choose the $260 cabin.
The $350 flat is under our budget.

feedback.es: La cabaña de $260 es la única opción dentro del presupuesto imaginario.

hint.es: Compara cada precio con el máximo de $300.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige la preferencia de Jo.

feedback.es: Jo prefiere el tren porque necesita una mesa para trabajar.

hint.es: Relaciona la opción con la necesidad mencionada.

prompt.es: Ordena la propuesta que combina dos preferencias.

answer.text: If we chose the hostel, we could save money and stay near the centre.

feedback.es: La propuesta une ahorro y ubicación bajo una misma condición.

hint.es: Abre con la condición y termina con las dos ventajas.

prompt.es: Une cada interlocutor con su prioridad.

feedback.es: Las prioridades permiten comparar opciones sin atribuir gustos nuevos.

prompt.es: ¿Qué propuesta reconoce un límite del tren nocturno?

choices.text: It would save a hotel night, but we might sleep badly.
It would save a hotel night and guarantee good sleep.

feedback.es: La primera opción presenta el ahorro y también el posible mal descanso.

prompt.es: Formula una decisión compartida dentro de $180.

feedback.es: Las variantes suman $160 y justifican una decisión compartida.

prompt.es: Escribe 70–100 palabras para resolver el viaje de Ava y Luis.

answer.text: If Ava and Luis had a $420 budget, the train and hotel would be the most comfortable, but they would keep only $10 for food. The bus and hotel would cost $350, so they could save $70, below Luis's minimum of $80. If I were them, I would recommend the bus and hostel for $280. It would be less private, but they could keep $140 for meals. They would choose it together: Luis's minimum would be met, and Ava would accept less privacy as a compromise.
accepted: If Ava and Luis had a $420 budget, the train and hotel would be the most comfortable, but they would keep only $10 for food. The bus and hotel would cost $350, so they could save $70, below Luis's minimum of $80. If I were them, I would recommend the bus and hostel for $280. It would be less private, but they could keep $140 for meals. They would choose it together: Luis's minimum would be met, and Ava would accept less privacy as a compromise.

With an imaginary budget of $420, the $410 train and hotel would offer Ava the most comfort but leave $10. The $350 bus and hotel would keep a comfortable room but leave only $70, below Luis's $80 minimum. The $280 bus and shared hostel could leave $140 but offer less privacy. If the food minimum were essential, I would advise the third option. They would agree because Luis keeps enough money and Ava accepts the shared room as the compromise.

feedback.es: Ambas negociaciones comparan opciones, verifican el ahorro y cierran una decisión conjunta.

origin.text: Presupuesto $420. Ava: comodidad. Luis: guardar mínimo $80 para comida. Opciones: tren+hotel $410/más cómodo; autobús+hotel $350/habitación cómoda; autobús+hostal $280/habitación compartida. Comparar dos y decidir.

prompt.es: Elige una habitación silenciosa dentro del límite de $110.

choices.text: Choose the $130 room because it is central.
Choose the $105 room beside a busy road.
Choose the $95 room: it is quiet and remains under the $110 limit.

feedback.es: La habitación de $95 cumple el límite y la necesidad de silencio.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada propuesta con beneficio y límite.

feedback.es: Las tres alternativas quedan comparables por coste, ventaja y límite.

prompt.es: Escribe 70–100 palabras para elegir un espacio de curso.

answer.text: If Inez and Tom had $240, the private room would give Inez quiet and privacy, but it would not include a projector. The shared studio would cost $160 and provide all the equipment, although other groups could be present. If I were them, I would recommend the shared studio and leave $80 unspent. They would choose it together: Tom would have the equipment, while Inez would accept less privacy so that they could remain well below their budget.
accepted: If Inez and Tom had $240, the private room would give Inez quiet and privacy, but it would not include a projector. The shared studio would cost $160 and provide all the equipment, although other groups could be present. If I were them, I would recommend the shared studio and leave $80 unspent. They would choose it together: Tom would have the equipment, while Inez would accept less privacy so that they could remain well below their budget.

With a $240 imaginary budget, Inez could choose the $210 private room for privacy, but Tom would have no projector. The $160 shared studio would include equipment, although it would offer less privacy. If I were them, I would advise selecting the shared studio. Inez would accept lower privacy, and Tom would get the equipment he needs. They would agree because the option costs $160, remains under budget and leaves exactly $80 unspent.

feedback.es: Las respuestas negocian privacidad y equipo con precios y una decisión verificable.

origin.text: Presupuesto $240. Inez: privacidad. Tom: equipo incluido. Opciones: estudio compartido $160/equipo/menos privacidad; sala privada $210/silencio/sin proyector; biblioteca $80/proyector/horario fijo. Comparar dos y decidir juntos.
